name: Salt & Pepper Chicken Wings with Cucumber, Tomato & Avocado Salad

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, mix together salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tsp salt
4 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.362 kg chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: Transfer the wings to a baking sheet and spread out in a single layer. Place in the oven and, turning halfway through cooking time, bake until crispy, 20-25 minutes.
Wash the green onions, trim ends, and thinly slice on an angle. Peel and mince the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, mix together the minced garlic, green onions, and sesame oil. Set aside.
Wash the tomatoes and cucumber. Halve the tomatoes and transfer to a medium bowl. Medium dice the cucumber and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkg grape tomatoes
1 ½ English cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice the onion and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit the avocados; scoop out the flesh with a spoon, medium dice, and add to the bowl.
Drizzle the salad with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the chicken wings are cooked, add the sesame oil mixture over top and toss to coat.
Serve the wings on a plate with salad on the side. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: chicken wings, split with tips removed
